entities.summary: Potito Starace is an Italian former professional tennis player on the ATP Tour. He achieved a career-high singles ranking of world no. 27 on October 15, 2007. Storace was a clay court specialist. He was banned from tennis for life by the Italian Tennis Federation and by the Tennis Integrity Unit for betting offences.
